name: Twilio
outlook:
What Twilio says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: revenueFor the fourth quarter ending December 31, 2026, Twilio is initiating a revenue range of $1.595 to $1.605 billion, which implies a reported revenue growth range of 17% to 17.5% and an organic revenue growth range of 11% to 12% year-over-year. Twilio expects fourth quarter non-GAAP gross profit to be similar to its organic revenue growth range.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: non-GAAP earnings per shareLastly, Twilio expects fourth quarter non-GAAP diluted earnings per share in a range of $1.48 to $1.53, based on non-GAAP weighted average diluted shares outstanding of 163 million.
  • Full year 2026: revenue growthFor fiscal year 2026, Twilio is raising its reported revenue growth outlook to 20% compared with 18% to 18.5% previously, and its organic revenue growth range outlook to 15% year-over-year compared with 13% to 13.5% previously.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 29, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
